claim_en: Burned every morning with the lamp-cleaning and between the suns with the lamp-lighting — CONTINUAL for the generations — and placed before the ark-cover where I will APPOINT MY WORD for you (the appointment-verb of EX25-05, at 30:6 and again at 30:36): the incense wired to the tamid cycle and to the oracle interface (Onkelos Exod 30).

No STRANGE incense, no burnt-offering, meal-offering, or libation on this altar (Onkelos Exod 30) — an unauthorized-input ban on an interface: the strange-token installed before the strange fire that will breach it.

source: Onkelos on Exod 30:10; the emergency override at Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 6
claim_en: Atonement on the horns once a year, most holy (Onkelos Exod 30) — the annual protocol; and the spine records its emergency override: in the calf crisis Moses invokes this schedule and is told to lift their heads NOW (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 6). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 30:12-16; the docket rows at Mishnah Shekalim 1:1 + 2:4 and Mishnah Megillah 3:4
claim_en: Each man the REDEMPTION of his soul — counted by token, never by head, that no plague come WHEN you count; the rate flat (the rich no more, the poor no less), a SEPARATION in the terumah word-family, to the Tent's service as remembrance — and the received translation CONVERTS THE CURRENCY (shekel to sela, twenty ma'in): the conversion-layer at the money register (Onkelos Exod 30). The case rows wait at Mishnah Shekalim 1:1 and its cluster.
The wash-verb rendered SANCTIFY throughout — hands and feet at entry and approach, wash-or-die, an everlasting statute (Onkelos Exod 30): hygiene decoded as sanctity law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 30:23-38; the karet rows at Mishnah Keritot 1:1
claim_en: The anointing oil and the incense both carry anti-duplication clauses — its LIKENESS you shall not make, not on common flesh, not for private smell — with the sanction CUT OFF (Onkelos Exod 30): formula-piracy carries karet, and both crimes sit on the case shelf's karet census (Mishnah Keritot 1:1, this exam's docket).

source: Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 9 through 11 with the Buber parallels
claim_en: Moses reasons the soul's price from the recorded tariffs — the talent, the libeler's hundred, the violator's fifty, and THIRTY from the goring ox's slave tariff of our own Exod 21:32 ('they exchanged their glory for the likeness of an ox') — and the answer is shown, not derived: the FIRE COIN from under the throne, THIS shall they give (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 9). The spine prices the calf from this corpus' chapter-21 machine. Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 9 (the census laws)
claim_en: Ten censuses enumerated from Egypt to the age to come; counting always by TOKENS (lambs, pebbles, half-shekels), never by heads; counted-for-need lacks none, counted-needlessly loses; and the acrostic computation — the tribal initials summing 597,000, the missing three thousand the calf's fallen: the census exists to know the loss (Midrash Tanchuma, Ki Tisa 9). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

Because the verse fixed a HALF, change-making generates surcharge law — the kalbon: who owes it, the exempt classes, one-or-two for joint payers (R. Meir's dispute), two for a sela paid and a shekel returned (Mishnah Shekalim 1:6). Seated from the Step 9 Ki Tisa exam, auto-seat law.

The denomination floated across the eras — darkonot, selaim, teva'in, the dinar proposal — and ALL HANDS STAY EQUAL at any coin (Mishnah Shekalim 2:4, R. Shimon against the sin-offering's by-his-means): the case shelf's own statement of the conversion-layer Onkelos performs at this verse (shekel rendered sela). Seated from the Step 9 Ki Tisa exam, auto-seat law.
